implementationPlan.description: Write Node-native red tests for a read-only certified-provider doctor: exact supported client/daemon versions and driver/host combinations, missing executable/auth denial/timeout/nonzero/malformed JSON, unknown/prerelease mismatch, safe direct argv, bounded output, no mutating provider commands, CLI malformed arguments, and providerReady versus executionReady:false. Use injected transport or a fake executable; no actual VM creation. Tests and error handling are mandatory.

Implement a protected module-relative versioned provider manifest and the smallest stdlib execFile probe/doctor/JSON CLI. Pin Multipass1.17.0 and official dated Ubuntu24.04 release-20261017 amd64/arm64 image URLs/SHA256; verify official references rather than floating aliases. Probe only version --format json, get local.driver and get client.primary-name. Use bounded timeout/maxBuffer and shell:false; no shell interpolation, launch/set/delete/mount operations, task-selected manifests or env readiness bypasses. Report prerequisite readiness separately from executionReady:false. Unknown/unsupported versions/hosts/drivers fail closed. Avoid claiming actual local platform certification from mocks.

Run node --test scripts/tests/local-runner.test.mjs fresh and capture counts. Review exactly once as an attacker: oversized/invalid provider output, injected executable/args, unknown host/driver/version, mutable manifest loading, and false readiness. Package/caller integration remains follow-up work; do not claim installed runtime enforcement.

comments.author: worker-cq-r02
comments.content: R02 handoff: 51/51 Node tests pass, 0 skips on Linux; no actual Multipass install/VM certification claimed. Initial behavioral RED was permissive baseline accepting unknown version (expected VERSION_UNSUPPORTED), not merely missing import. Eight controlled mutants in disposable copied modules were rejected by assertion tests: version, client/daemon match, driver, executionReady, shell:false, output bound, read-only argv, sanitized diagnostics. Official v1.17.0 sources establish +win/+mac release suffixes (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/canonical/multipass/v1.17.0/src/cmake/versioning.cmake), JSON multipass/multipassd fields, and default primary getter <empty> for disabled primary (get.cpp; client-primary-name.md). Dated official source image hashes verified at https://cloud-images.ubuntu.com/releases/noble/release-20261017/SHA256SUMS. Doctor only probes version --format json, get local.driver, get client.primary-name, and always executionReady:false. Bounded 10s/64KiB execFile uses SIGKILL to handle uncooperative clients; source CLI, real output overflow and real timeout covered. Provider manifest is module-relative/frozen; no environment override. Packaging, caller activation, protected installed runtime, resource/boundary certification and VM lifecycle remain later tasks. Adversarial review found/fixed raw unexpected error-message leak; regression verifies secrets/paths never escape. No shared state writes or provisioning side effects; no source outside the five approved paths modified.
